text:
Alex R: Quick sync on the ACME pilot — customer wants final POC success gates, golden prompt set, security Q answers, and pricing steer by Friday EOD. Can we align owners?
Maria S: I can own the golden prompt set + scoring rubric. thinking ~200 golden examples across 4 intents?
Samir K: For scoring, recommend automated BLEU-like + human pass/fail for edge cases. suggested threshold: >= 90% automated on core intents OR >= 85% human pass rate.
Jordan T: Need to call out latency SLO and hallucination gate. Customer requires median latency <150ms and hallucination <3% on golden set.
Dana P: Security Qs: I grabbed the customer's questionnaire — a few asks about data residency and KMS. @sec-ops-bot can you confirm if we can commit to EU-only residency for pilot?
sec-ops-bot: EU-only residency for pilot is available on Dedicated or Private; hosted API can be routed to eu-west region but not isolated. Will flag required contract language.
Alex R: Pricing Q — customer is evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted. For a 3-week pilot (limited traffic) they asked for a committed rate card. Maria/Samir, include estimated cost per 1M tokens for both Hosted and Dedicated (with burst config) in the doc.
Maria S: Will do. Planning to provide two cost scenarios: "minimal" batch=0 (low latency) and "batch-optimized" for cost. Also including caching assumptions (prefix cache hit rate 20%).
Samir K: For the eval harness, here is the minimal config we'll run locally then hand to the customer:
```
- golden_set.csv (200 rows)
- harness config: sample_rate=1.0, retries=1, timeout_ms=30000
- metrics: automated_score, human_pass_pct, latency_ms_median, token_cost_est
- regression_gate: any drop >5% relative to baseline triggers rollback
```
Jordan T: Who's doing the baseline? we need a baseline model + quant config. suggest using model-x v1.3 (hosted) and quantized variant for Dedicated.
Dana P: I'll take the security questionnaire replies. Need answers by Thursday to avoid legal review bottleneck.
Alex R: Action items: Maria = golden prompts + cost scenarios; Samir = harness config + scoring thresholds; Jordan = baseline model + latency verification; Dana = security Qs answers to legal. Owners, please drop artifacts in the shared drive and ping me when ready.
Maria S: ETA Thursday noon for golden set draft.
Samir K: I'll push harness repo + baseline scripts by Thursday 5pm.
Jordan T: I'll run latency tests on Dedicated nodetype and post results by Thursday 3pm.
Dana P: Security Q answers in first pass by Wednesday EOD, will label items that need legal.
Alex R: Perfect. If anyone sees an enterprise blocker (SLA, SOC2 evidence, export controls), call it out in-thread. Otherwise we'll present this package to the customer Friday morning. :thumbsup:
Maria S: quick Q — golden set labeling: binary pass/fail or multi-class error type? I vote pass/fail + error_type tag for triage.
Samir K: Agreed. pass/fail primary. error_type: hallucination, omission, format, latency, other.
Jordan T: Also add a simple sample prompt for the harness README so the customer can reproduce: "Summarize the following legal clause in plain english ( <= 40 words )"
Alex R: thanks team — keeping this tight will help us close. I'll schedule a 15m demo rehearsal Friday 8:30am PT.
Maria S: noted. I'll bring the golden set link and scoring README.
Samir K: will bring harness runbook.
Dana P: will confirm security answers status in the morning.
sec-ops-bot: Automated note: security questionnaire PDF uploaded to drive by Dana P at 1719998960.
